question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Principal
solution: The correct answer is **'Major'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Principal** means most important; main. (**सबसे महत्वपूर्ण; मुख्‍य**) • **Example**- the principal characters in a play the **principal **characters in a play • **Major **refers to very large, important or serious. **(बहुत बड़ा, महत्वपूर्ण या गंभीर)** • **​****Example**- The patient needs **major **heart surgery. • Hence the correct answer is **'Major'**. Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Minor **refers to not very big, serious or important (when compared with others). **(जो अधिक बड़ा, गंभीर या आवश्‍यक न हो (औरों की तुलना में), गौण, छोटा, कम महत्वपूर्ण)** • **Believable **means that can be believed.** (जिसका विश्‍वास किया जा सके; विश्‍वसनीय)** • **Flawless** refers to perfect; with no faults or mistakes. **(परिपूर्ण; निर्दोष)** 60:T9fb, The correct answer is **"Somebody will deliver these parcels later."**
